content: Drizzle ORM vs Prisma in 2026: Prisma 7 rewrote its query engine (TS/WASM, ~1.6MB vs old 14MB Rust engine) narrowing the cold-start gap, but Drizzle (~7.4KB gzip, zero runtime deps, SQL-like TS API) still wins decisively for serverless/edge cold starts (roughly 100-300ms vs 500-1500ms+ for Prisma in tight environments). For Vercel serverless functions with per-request cold starts, Drizzle is the better fit; Prisma is fine if richer schema tooling/migrations DX is prioritized over cold-start latency.
